name: alternateoffice
description: Local-first office suite (docs, sheets, slides, pdf, markdown, html)

scripts.test: npm run test -w @alternateoffice/i18n && npm run test -w @alternateoffice/electron-utils && npm run test -w @alternateoffice/font-metrics && npm run test -w @alternateoffice/docx-engine && npm run test -w @alternateoffice/pdf2docx && npm run test -w @alternateoffice/html2docx && npm run test -w @alternateoffice/zip-gate && npm run test -w @alternateoffice/file-parse && npm run test -w @alternateoffice/pptx-engine && npm run test -w @alternateoffice/xlsx-gateway && npm run test -w @alternateoffice/pptx-ops && npm run test -w @alternateoffice/pptx-render && npm run test -w @alternateoffice/pipelines && npm run test -w @alternateoffice/ai-search && npm run test -w @alternateoffice/agent-core && npm run test -w @alternateoffice/ai-provider && npm run test -w @alternateoffice/project-store && npm run test -w @alternateoffice/cli && npm run test -w @alternateoffice/ui && npm run test -w @alternateoffice/docs && npm run test -w @alternateoffice/sheets && npm run test -w @alternateoffice/shell && npm run test -w @alternateoffice/slides && npm run test -w @alternateoffice/pdf && npm run test -w @alternateoffice/markdown && npm run test -w @alternateoffice/html
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @alternateoffice/i18n && npm run typecheck -w @alternateoffice/electron-utils && npm run typecheck -w @alternateoffice/font-metrics && npm run typecheck -w @alternateoffice/docx-engine && npm run typecheck -w @alternateoffice/pdf2docx && npm run typecheck -w @alternateoffice/html2docx && npm run typecheck -w @alternateoffice/zip-gate && npm run typecheck -w @alternateoffice/file-parse && npm run typecheck -w @alternateoffice/pptx-engine && npm run typecheck -w @alternateoffice/xlsx-gateway && npm run typecheck -w @alternateoffice/pptx-ops && npm run typecheck -w @alternateoffice/pptx-render && npm run typecheck -w @alternateoffice/pipelines && npm run typecheck -w @alternateoffice/ai-search && npm run typecheck -w @alternateoffice/agent-core && npm run typecheck -w @alternateoffice/ai-provider && npm run typecheck -w @alternateoffice/project-store && npm run typecheck -w @alternateoffice/cli && npm run typecheck -w @alternateoffice/ui && npm run typecheck -w @alternateoffice/docs && npm run typecheck -w @alternateoffice/sheets && npm run typecheck -w @alternateoffice/shell && npm run typecheck -w @alternateoffice/slides && npm run typecheck -w @alternateoffice/pdf && npm run typecheck -w @alternateoffice/markdown && npm run typecheck -w @alternateoffice/html
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n docs,sheets,slides,pdf,markdown,html,shell -c blue,green,yellow,red,cyan,white,magenta "npm run dev:renderer -w @alternateoffice/docs" "npm run dev:renderer -w @alternateoffice/sheets" "npm run dev:renderer -w @alternateoffice/slides" "npm run dev:renderer -w @alternateoffice/pdf" "npm run dev:renderer -w @alternateoffice/markdown" "npm run dev:renderer -w @alternateoffice/html" "cross-env DOCS_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5173 SHEETS_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5174 SLIDES_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5175 PDF_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5176 MARKDOWN_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5177 HTML_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5178 npm run dev -w @alternateoffice/shell"
scripts.build:all: npm run build -w @alternateoffice/docs && npm run build -w @alternateoffice/sheets && npm run build -w @alternateoffice/slides && npm run build -w @alternateoffice/pdf && npm run build -w @alternateoffice/markdown && npm run build -w @alternateoffice/html && npm run build -w @alternateoffice/cli && npm run build -w @alternateoffice/shell
scripts.dist:mac: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run native:build:universal -w @alternateoffice/sheets && npm run dist:mac -w @alternateoffice/shell
scripts.dist:win: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run dist:win -w @alternateoffice/shell
scripts.dist:linux: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run dist:linux -w @alternateoffice/shell
